abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study presents the MR appearances of five women with a total of six proven dermoid cysts of the ovary with malignant transformation. To our knowledge, the MR findings of this entity have not been reported. CONCLUSION: The lesions appeared to be fat-containing tumors with a solid component (4/6) that extended transmurally (4/6) and extensively invaded neighboring pelvic organs (3/6). The supervening malignancy was squamous cell carcinoma in four tumors, melanoma in one, and transitional cell carcinoma in one. The mode of spread differed from that of common ovarian tumors in that it included transmural extension and local invasion, reflecting squamous cell carcinoma.
abstract_ja: 目的:悪性転化を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫の証明された6例を、5名の女性で提示し、そのMR所見を示す。我々の知る限り、この病態のMR所見は報告されていない。結論:病変は脂肪を含む腫瘍で、充実性成分を有し(4/6)、経壁性に進展し(4/6)、隣接する骨盤臓器に広範囲に浸潤していた(3/6)と思われた。悪性転化は、扁平上皮癌が4腫瘍、黒色腫が1腫瘍、移行上皮癌が1腫瘍であった。転移の様式は、扁平上皮癌を反映して経壁性進展と局所浸潤を含む点で、一般的な卵巣腫瘍とは異なっていた。
